properties.name: app.embedding.max-batch-size
properties.description: Maximum number of inputs accepted in a single embeddings request.

properties.name: app.embedding.max-input-length
properties.description: Maximum number of characters allowed per input text.

properties.name: app.embedding.provider.type
properties.description: Embedding provider type. Supported values: OLLAMA, OPENAI, OPENROUTER.

properties.name: app.embedding.provider.connect-timeout
properties.description: Timeout used to establish the HTTP connection to the embedding provider.

properties.name: app.embedding.provider.request-timeout
properties.description: Maximum time allowed for a synchronous embedding request to complete.

properties.name: app.embedding.provider.ollama-url
properties.description: Full URL for the Ollama embeddings endpoint.

properties.name: app.embedding.provider.openai-url
properties.description: Full URL for the OpenAI embeddings endpoint.

properties.name: app.embedding.provider.openrouter-url
properties.description: Full URL for the OpenRouter embeddings endpoint.

properties.name: app.embedding.provider.api-key
properties.description: API key used as Bearer token when calling the selected embedding provider.

properties.name: app.pgvector.initialize-schema
properties.description: Whether to initialize pgvector schema objects automatically.

properties.name: app.pgvector.schema-name
properties.description: Database schema name used to create and query vector tables.

properties.name: app.pgvector.schema-validation
properties.description: Whether to validate that the configured schema exists.

properties.name: app.pgvector.index-type
properties.description: Vector ANN index type. Supported values: NONE, HNSW, IVFFLAT.

properties.name: app.pgvector.distance-type
properties.description: Vector distance type. Supported values: COSINE_DISTANCE, EUCLIDEAN_DISTANCE, NEGATIVE_INNER_PRODUCT.

properties.name: app.pgvector.max-document-batch-size
properties.description: Maximum number of documents to process in a single batch operation.
